answer: A sybil operator's only edge is minting — identities are free, so the attack wins wherever power ships free with a fresh id. Close it: derive voting weight solely from verifiable useful-work receipts — correctness proofs this identity computed over prior-epoch transactions, non-parallelizable across puppets. A thousand-puppet farm must then perform a thousandfold river of real work, and the ledger gains what the attacker spent. Cheap minting becomes costly donation: onyx-immutable receipts bridge identity to contribution, and the farm hoping to skim ends up funding the economy.
